{{Quote|Oh, Leida!|Peermaid seeing Leida Mothma's wedding dress for the first time|<ref name="One Year Later" />}}
A [[human]] '''peermaid''' from the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]]. They were a [[peermaid]] for [[Leida Mothma]] during her [[wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma|wedding]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on [[Chandrila]] in [[4 BBY]]. They had light skin, [[color|red]] [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="One Year Later" /> On the first [[Standard day|day]] of the three day ceremony, Leida led them with number of other girls to see her [[Leida Mothma's wedding dress|wedding gown]].<ref name="One Year Later" /> The following day they were present for [[Perrin Fertha]]'s speech to Leida and [[Stekan Sculdun]]. During the first two days they wore a blue [[Clothing|dress]] with a gold [[belt]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> On the third day, they watched Leida and Stekan Sculdun marriage ceremony and later watched the couple's dance during wedding reception. During which they wore a gold shirt with a blue skirt and gold belt. Later during the reception, a [[speaker droid]] began to play music and the peermaid joined others in dancing to the music.<ref name="Harvest">{{Andor|Harvest}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The peermaid was portrayed by [[Nuala Peberdy]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the episode's first episode, "[[One Year Later]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Harvest" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> In the episode's credits they are identified as "peermaid #2" but in the episode's subtitles they are identified as "Peer Maid 2".<ref name="One Year Later" />
